dedupe_keys.name: bc stan building energy model calibration

description: bc-stan provides Stan code for Bayesian calibration of building-energy models. Its README links the statistical method and application papers, and documents R and Python entry points to Stan models with and without predictive inference. Users supply building-model outputs and observed performance data; the code estimates uncertain model parameters and predictive distributions. Geographic coverage follows the buildings and measurements supplied by the user, not a fixed national stock. GitHub metadata states MIT licensing. A limitation is that posterior estimates depend on prior assumptions, observation quality and whether the structural model can represent the building; the example was not run in this review. Calibration can help assess retrofit or operational scenarios before connecting building demand to energy-network simulations. The catalogue's EnergyPlus record is a possible source of detailed building-model output, but this repository does not require that engine. No measurement data, Stan binary or posterior sample was downloaded.
inputs: Building energy model predictions, observations and priors
name: bc-stan building energy model calibration
notes: G7 G7-1986. Prepared draft only. Metadata review on 2026-09-28; no models, data or archives downloaded. Related-resource comparisons are reviewer mappings, not tested interoperability.
